name: Sjuhäradsleden, etapp 6: Karlsaflogarna - Blackered
description: Karlsaflogarna to Blackered. Candidate import from normalized research; verify current notices before publication.
waterSources: No confirmed potable-water point on Etapp 6: Official Etapp 6 sources do not identify a certified potable-water point on the stage. Carry full-day water and treat/filter natural water.
notes: Naturkartan carries a whole-trail warning that Sjuhäradsleden is not fully quality-assured and may have signage/passability/accessibility shortcomings, while Västsverige says stages 3-7 are quality-assured. Västkuststiftelsen's 2025 report says quality work continued with stage division, signs, inspections and maintenance, but does not fully remove the Naturkartan warning.

Naturkartan GPX/API and Västsverige KML agree on the broad corridor and endpoints, but the raw official-linked linework contains duplicate/parallel/spur segments near Rölle. OSM is topologically cleaner after reversing, but has a start offset near Karlsaflogarna.

One access pass observed a coordinate near 57.713847, 13.208498 as a possible current Naturkartan geometry end. The full GPX/API audit shows this is part of the Rölle split/stub geometry, not the official Blackered endpoint. The valid Etapp 6 endpoint is around 57.766163, 13.282369 and is corroborated by Etapp 7 start.
Västsverige page data includes a coordinate around 57.7239212, 13.2284725, while OSM/Swetrails place Raska-Minas stuga around 57.7253705, 13.2350771, closer to the route/object cluster.
Borås/Västsverige mention Komskälet as Blackered access about 2 km away, but the access lane did not find a current Västtrafik stop-area record for Komskälet/Kommskälet on 2026-04-29.
Normalize the Rölle duplicate/parallel/spur linework into one continuous Etapp 6 mainline before any route import.

facilities.name: Karlsaflogarna start access cluster
facilities.description: Start access area for Etapp 6 at Karlsaflogarna. Official sources indicate parking/information at or near the endpoint, but exact object placement and capacity were not verified. Deduplicate with section 5 Karlsaflogarna end access.

facilities.name: Toarps vindskydd
facilities.description: Small shelter/rest point near the Karlsaflogarna/Toarp start area. Source data does not confirm water. Verify relationship to Karlsaflogarna/Toarp shelter naming and whether it is intended for overnight use.

facilities.name: Toarps firepit
facilities.description: Fireplace/grill near the Toarps shelter, a short detour from the stage start. Fire use must be subject to SÄRF/Krisinformation fire-ban status.

facilities.name: Toarp picnic table
facilities.description: Picnic/rest point near the route shortly after the Karlsaflogarna start. OSM-only facility; verify before publication if visible as a named POI.

facilities.name: Raska-Minas stuga
facilities.description: Restored 1800s croft with turf roof and historical interior, open to the public as a day-use rest/picnic place. Official and field sources describe it as suitable for eating packed food indoors, not as lodging. Västsverige page data gives an alternate coordinate around 57.7239212, 13.2284725 that appears farther from the route/object than OSM/Swetrails. Do not classify the cottage itself as overnight accommodation.

facilities.name: Raska-Minas vindskydd
facilities.description: Wind shelter near Raska-Minas where official sources and recent Komoot evidence indicate overnighting is possible. The official description says the overnight shelter is about 100 m east into the forest from the cottage. OSM has had uncertainty about exact separation from the cottage; verify exact object placement if normalization needs high-precision shelter coordinates.
